title: ProblemMiningResult
description: Schema contract for structured problem dorking and live practitioner complaint mining output emitted by mine_problem_dorks.py.

domain.description: Target domain, workflow, or industry being investigated.

operator.description: Target persona or operational actor (empty string if general).

track.description: Target discovery track (commercial WTP vs free utility vs all).

live_fetched_count.description: Total number of live complaint signals fetched from public APIs.

dorks_generated_count.description: Total number of precision search dorks generated across all streams.

live_signals.description: List of real practitioner complaints and friction signals fetched from public APIs.

source.description: Origin platform (e.g. 'Hacker News (Algolia API)', 'GitHub Issues API', 'Reddit').

title.description: Title of the post, issue, or discussion thread.

url.description: Direct URL to the public comment or issue.

excerpt.description: Raw unedited text excerpt describing the operational friction or manual workaround.

author_or_actor.description: Author username or operational role if available.

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp or publication date if available.

relevance_hint.description: Contextual hint explaining why this signal represents authentic workflow friction.

dorks.description: Categorized Google and forum search dorks across 5 distinct research streams.

community.description: Community and Reddit pain-phrase search queries.

filetypes.description: Filetype dorks hunting public SOPs, spreadsheets, checklists, and manual templates.

job_postings.description: Job board queries hunting paid human glue-work and manual data-entry salaries.

software_gaps.description: Review and support queries hunting competitor limitations and feature gaps.

regional_grievances.description: Regional and hyper-local grievance, tender, and statutory regulation queries.
